acceptance: the callable exports every reachable page, including successors of empty pages
the greatest revision determines each SKU's state regardless of order, including tombstones and duplicate rows
all reachable rows validate; greatest-revision payload conflicts fail, but superseded conflicts and unreachable page contents do not
required field types are strict; unknown metadata is ignored
CSV is sorted UTF-8 without BOM, with canonical minimal quoting and LF record terminators
parse, acquisition, and validation failures preserve an existing destination byte-for-byte
the actual CLI both exports a valid late capture and rejects a late invalid capture without replacing the prior destination
